# x402 Doctor

> Checks x402, MPP and L402 paid API endpoints the way a paying AI agent would, before the agent pays: is it safe to pay (go / caution / no_go), does the price match what is advertised, can the payout address receive, is it on the OFAC sanctions list, is it testnet-only, and did the seller deliver when it was bought. For sellers: a free diagnosis of a broken 402 with the exact fix as code. Free web check; paid API from $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Base, Solana, Algorand or Stellar, RLUSD on the XRP Ledger) or MPP; MCP server at https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/mcp.

Backed by a daily Trust Index of ~42,000 paid x402 and MPP endpoints across Base, Solana, Algorand, the XRP Ledger, Stellar and Arc, from the CDP Bazaar, Circle's Agent Marketplace and other indexes. No account or API key needed.

## For agents
- [Agent instructions (skill.md)](https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/skill.md): how to use the preflight, the diagnosis and the MCP tools, and how to pay
- [OpenAPI](https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/openapi.json): every paid route with its price, input and output schema
- [x402 discovery document](https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/.well-known/x402)
- MCP server (streamable HTTP): https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/mcp, with the free tools `x402_quick_check` and `x402_payee_check` (is each payTo bound to the seller's ERC-8004 agent?)
- Agent skills: `npx skills add Fizzl13/x402-doctor`, or in Claude Code `/plugin marketplace add Fizzl13/x402-doctor` then `/plugin install x402-doctor@fizzl`. Every Fizzl skill: https://github.com/Fizzl13/fizzl-skills

## Paid API
- `GET /api/v1/preflight?url=<endpoint>&max_usd=0.05` ($0.001): before paying an x402 endpoint: go, caution or no_go with reasons and the cheapest option that will settle
- `GET /api/v1/preflight/batch?url=<a>&url=<b>` ($0.005): the same for up to 10 endpoints
- `GET /api/v1/preflight/deep?url=<endpoint>` ($0.01): preflight plus the full diagnosis, history and seller checks, for expensive calls
- `GET /api/v1/diagnose?url=<endpoint>` ($0.01): the full diagnosis of an x402 endpoint, check by check
- `GET /api/v1/fix?url=<endpoint>` ($0.05): the fixes as code for the seller's stack, plus improvements for a working endpoint (ERC-8004 identity, Base Builder Code, x402scan ownership proof, skill.md, browser paywall)
- `GET /api/v1/delivery-check?url=<endpoint>` ($0.25): one real purchase of the endpoint; the public result says whether it was charged and delivered

## Free
- [Web check](https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/): paste an endpoint for the full report
- [Trust Index](https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/trust): which paid endpoints are payable today, their history, and the weekly spot-buy results
- [x402 on Stellar](https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/stellar), [on Algorand](https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/algorand), [on the XRP Ledger](https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/xrpl) and [on X Layer](https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/xlayer): every endpoint on that network, payable or not and why
- [For sellers](https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/sellers): the most common x402 seller mistakes and how to fix them
- [Payment proof check](https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/settlement): the on-chain transaction behind a PAYMENT-RESPONSE header
- `GET /api/trust?url=<resource>`: one resource's 30-day track record
- `POST /api/trust/submit` with `{"url": "https://…"}`: a seller adds their own endpoint (not in a registry yet) to the daily scan, after a live check that it answers 402 (MCP: free tools `x402_trust_add` and `x402_trust_record`)
- [x402 Trust Index dataset on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/datasets/x402Fizzl/x402-trust-index): every endpoint in the latest scan with its verdict, reasons, price, networks, category and 30-day history (JSONL), and go / caution / no_go per day (CSV); CC BY 4.0, updated after every daily scan
- [x402 health report, October 2026](https://fizzl.eu/research/x402-health-october-2026/): what the Trust Index shows about the x402 market: payable share, seller concentration, networks, prices, the most common seller mistakes with fixes, and the spot-buy results

## Optional
- [Fizzl](https://fizzl.eu/llms.txt): the other Fizzl services (pre-sign checks, agent wallet, trading signals)
- [Source code](https://github.com/Fizzl13/x402-doctor) and the [GitHub Action](https://github.com/Fizzl13/x402-doctor-action) for CI

## Fizzl Pass
A Fizzl Pass holder (Bronze comes with Agent Wallet Pro) sends its signed proof in the `X-Fizzl-Pass` header and gets 5 times the free limits, counted per pass instead of per IP. The proof comes from the Agent Wallet dashboard; anyone can check a wallet's pass at https://wallet.fizzl.eu/v1/pass/status?wallet=<address>.

Buy a pass for your own wallet over x402, no account needed: GET https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/api/v1/pass/bronze ($5, 30 days), /silver ($20, 90 days) or /gold ($60, 180 days); the answer's claim_url returns the signed proof once the payment has settled (most x402 clients cap a payment at $1 by default: raise it). Tiers and prices free at GET /api/v1/pass.

Credit back: after a paid call from a wallet a pass covers, 10% of the price (Silver 20%, Gold 30%) goes into the pass's vault, spendable at x402 Doctor, presign-guard, Ichimoku Signal and Fizzl Buy. A paid call with the `X-Fizzl-Pass` header and no payment is paid from the vault when it holds enough (response header `x-fizzl-vault: paid`); a failed call gives it back. Over MCP (https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/mcp) the same holds: send the header on the HTTP request; a paid tool call earns credit back, and a tool call without payment is paid from the vault (result `_meta["fizzl/vault"]`). Balance: GET https://x402-doctor.fizzl.eu/api/v1/vault with the same header. Credit can only be spent at Fizzl and can't be paid out; Bronze and Silver credit ends 12 months after the last credit.
